targets.rawSql: SELECT MetricDate AS time, Value AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'active_installations' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time
SELECT MetricDate AS time, Value AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'active_installations_7d' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time
SELECT MetricDate AS time, Value AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'active_installations_30d' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time

SELECT MetricDate AS time, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'sessions') / nullIf(sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'active_installations'), 0) AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName IN ('sessions', 'active_installations') AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) GROUP BY MetricDate ORDER BY time

SELECT MetricDate AS time, MetricName AS metric, Value AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName IN ('active_installations', 'sessions') AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time

SELECT Dimension1 AS app_version, Dimension2 AS os_family, Dimension3 AS release_channel, sum(Value) AS observed_installations FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'installation_distribution' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) GROUP BY app_version, os_family, release_channel ORDER BY observed_installations DESC
SELECT MetricDate AS time, Value AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'new_installations' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time
SELECT MetricDate AS time, Value AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'returning_installations' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time
